card.name: Spaces and links before dose numbers
card.fires_on: Blank spaces, commas, and small linking words (for, or, is, =) right before a dose figure or expansion in dosing sections, especially pediatric ones.

modes.label: Gap before a dose number
modes.description: A space or small word just before the mg amount in a dosing statement.
modes.example: Irritability associated with autistic disorder – pediatric patients (2.4)<< >>2 mg/day 5 to 1

modes.label: Link before an expansion
modes.description: An equals sign after an abbreviation such as DRESS, just before its spelled-out meaning.
modes.example: otransferase, DRESS<< =>> Drug Rash with Eosinophilia and

modes.label: Joiner in dosing headings
modes.description: A small word such as for or or in a pediatric dosing heading or sentence.
modes.example: 2.2 Dosing for Seizures Associated with Lennox-Gastaut Syndrome<< or>> Dravet Syndrome • The starting dosage
